name: JoyCaption
summary: The open-source uncensored vision-language captioning model built from the ground up to describe anatomy, poses, art styles & lighting accurately for Flux/SDXL LoRA training.
ranking_rationale: Zero refusal filters—describes explicit anatomy, camera angles & booru/natural-language details accurately (trade-off: requires ~16GB+ VRAM — or 4-bit NF4 quantization on 8–12GB cards to batch-caption locally).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Zero refusal filters—describes explicit anatomy, camera angles & booru/natural-language details accurately
Dramatically improves FLUX.1 & SDXL LoRA training adherence over censored VLMs
100% free open-weight on Hugging Face & ComfyUI nodes
cons: Requires ~16GB+ VRAM (or 4-bit NF4 quantization on 8–12GB cards) to batch-caption locally
Dataset preparation utility rather than end-user chatbot
